svg.title: LLM smartness versus cost, by reasoning effort
svg.desc: The horizontal axis is average US dollar cost per Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index task, on a logarithmic scale. The vertical axis is the Intelligence Index v4.3.2 score from zero to sixty. Seven model families have separate colored curves; numbered points indicate low to max reasoning effort. Upper left is better on these two metrics. Gemini low is omitted because cost is unavailable; Gemini xhigh and max are unsupported. An exact table follows the chart.
svg.text: Same model, different reasoning effort. Which setting buys enough capability for your task?
X = benchmark cost per task (USD, log scale) Y = measured capability score Upper-left is better.
Published measurements, not simulated curves. Cost includes the benchmark's token usage; it is not Copilot AIC.
Capability / Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2
Average cost per benchmark task (USD) | logarithmic scale: equal spacing means equal cost ratios

svg.text: Every cell = cost per task / capability score
Source refreshed: 21 Oct 2026. Costs rounded for display; small score differences are not decisive.
Source: artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models. Selected seven-model comparison; not an exhaustive or coding-only ranking.
Claude: adaptive reasoning, default fallback. Gemini low: cost unavailable, so not plotted. Effort is not a standardized budget.
GPT-5.6 Sol uses retained 29 Sep data because it is absent from the refreshed leaderboard; GPT-6.1 Sol uses 21 Oct data.
